# Frame (fixture: EVASIVE method defence - adversarial case 1)

## Gap statement

Prior sorters report high accuracy on factory hardware (established).
No work quantifies the desktop-hardware case (not established).
Repair shops with the burden cannot afford the studied platforms (why it matters).

## Literature themes

Weight-based sorting treats each part as a point mass. A single mass reading
per part sidesteps the visual-similarity problem that defeats camera-based
sorters, and resolving that reading to a tenth of a gram is what makes the
later comparison against tactile-rich systems meaningful.
